As Saratoga Invt (SAR) Stock Rose, Black Diamond Capital Management Has Boosted Stake; Lvw Advisors Has Boosted Its Apple (AAPL) Stake
June 25, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Black Diamond Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Saratoga Invt Corp (SAR) by 2.12% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Black Diamond Capital Management Llc bought 15,094 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.39% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 728,454 shares of the company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $15.16 million, up from 713,360 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Black Diamond Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Saratoga Invt Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $159.13 million market cap company. The stock increased 4.33% or $1.051 during the last trading session, reaching $25.33. About 120,122 shares traded or 659.69% up from the average. Saratoga Investment Corp. (NYSE:SAR) has risen 7.20% since June 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.37% the S&P500.
